          Reset options

          Because your vault is encrypted on this device, no one — not even the developer — can read your data without your password. Pick one of the paths below.

          Option 1 · Reset with recovery code

          If you set up a recovery code, you saved it when you created the vault — in an email to yourself, a printout or a password manager. Paste it to set a new master password.

          Recovery not set up

          No recovery code was generated for this vault. Once you regain access, set one up under Set up email recovery in the sidebar.
